surfaces.role_variants: Any REKA admin (platform_admins row) gets AXLE. Eight independent rights (capabilities.ts:11-40): Workspaces, People, Models & keys, Usage & cost, Library, Learning, Settings & operations, View as a workspace. Nav hides pages whose right is missing (AdminApp.tsx:127,138); a read-only admin sees only Overview, Issues, Audit trail. Direct URL shows a gate card naming the right. Overview cost tiles and charts show a dash without Usage & cost. Rights edited on People > person > REKA rights; you cannot remove your own People right (src/features/people/PeopleDirectory.tsx:1018).

notes: Captured from the repo's own local preview mode (npm run dev equivalent, VITE_BACKEND=local, port 3109) with fictional data written to browser localStorage (isogen:platform:v1). Health card, Operations and server Analytics/Audit only render against the live Supabase backend, so the local fallbacks are shown. Live public sign-in capture was blocked by the session's permission classifier; the repo's own guide shot of the live sign-in is included instead.
